fidelity: F2a — Zubieta 3-Branch Equivalent Circuit with Voltage-Dependent C(V) + Thermal ODE
source: Zubieta & Bonert (2000), IEEE Trans. Ind. Appl. 36(1), 199-205; Conway (1999), Electrochemical Supercapacitors, Plenum; Rafik et al. (2007), J. Power Sources 165, 928-934; Berrueta et al. (2019), IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron. 66(6), 4750-4759

unit.name: Generic 3000 F / 2.7 V carbon/carbon EDLC cell (Maxwell BCAP3000 class) — Zubieta 3-branch identification

C0.note: Constant (voltage-independent) part of immediate-branch differential capacitance. Zubieta C(V)=C0+kv*V; here C0 ~0.8*C_rated
C0.source: Zubieta & Bonert (2000), IEEE Trans. Ind. Appl. 36(1), 199

kv.note: Voltage coefficient of immediate-branch capacitance. Differential C_imm(V)=C0+kv*V models double-layer C rising with V (Helmholtz/Gouy-Chapman)
kv.source: Zubieta & Bonert (2000); Rafik et al. (2007), J. Power Sources 165, 928

Ri.note: Immediate-branch series resistance (ESR), ~0.29 mOhm; dominates fast charge/discharge and Joule heating

Rd.note: Delayed-branch resistance; charge redistribution over seconds-to-minutes

Rl.note: Long-term branch resistance; redistribution over minutes-to-hours

R_leak.note: Parallel leakage / self-discharge resistance across the immediate branch (~1 uA/F class)

E_a_esr.note: Activation energy for ESR (Arrhenius). EDLC ionic transport in porous carbon is weakly activated
E_a_esr.source: Berrueta et al. (2019), IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron. 66(6), 4750; Rafik et al. (2007)

cp_cell.note: Effective specific heat of EDLC cell (carbon/electrolyte/can composite)
cp_cell.source: Berrueta et al. (2019), IEEE Trans. Ind. Electron.

hA_amb.note: Convective heat-transfer coeff * surface area to ambient (natural convection on cylindrical can)

temperature.note: -40 to 65 degC; EDLC operates over a very wide temperature range
